See the affected model
 Taylor Ardrey USA TODAY Nov. 9, 2026, 12:11 p.m. ET Hear this story Ford Motor Company is recalling more than 36,000 vehicles due to a defect with the seat function, which could raise the risk of injury.
 According to a recall notice posted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, the front passenger seat can unexpectedly move in certain vehicles.
 "The Rear Audio Control Module (RACM) may inadvertently command the chauffeur seat feature, causing the front passenger seat to adjust forward, rearward, or recline unexpectedly without occupant input," the recall notice detailed.
 Here's what we know about the model of vehicle included in the recall and what car owners should do next.
 More car recalls: Hyundai recalls over 37,000 vehicles. See the affected models What model is included in the Ford recall?
 According to the NHTSA, 36,994 units were potentially affected. It includes the following model:
 2025-2027 Lincoln Navigator
 The recall number is 26S77. Per the recall safety report , the issue can put the front seat occupant in an "unsafe seating position" or affect the riders behind them.

 Owners are advised to take their vehicle to the dealership to update the software needed to disable chauffeur mode. The remedy is free of charge.
 Notification letters will be sent out in November.
 You can reach Ford customer service at 866-436-7332.
